meta.title: 相机测试Lumix L10 对比 Fujifilm X100
meta.title_en: Lumix L10 vs Fujifilm X100: A Real-World Test

scenes.context: 摄影师朱利亚将Fujifilm X100与Lumix L10进行实际对比拍摄测试，两者都是轻便日常旅行相机。
sentences: Put two cameras to a real-world test.
两者定位都是轻便旅行机。
paraphrase: Put two cameras to a real-world test.
scenes.speak: Put two cameras to a real-world test. Both are light travel companions.

scenes.context: 富士是APS-C画幅约4000万像素配35mmF2定焦，Lumix是M4/3约2000万像素配24-75mm变焦。
sentences: Lumix: M4/3 with a zoom lens.
paraphrase: Lumix: M4/3 with a zoom lens.
scenes.speak: Fuji: APS-C with about 40MP. Lumix: M4/3 with a zoom lens.

scenes.context: 传感器越大进光量越多，低光下画面更干净、背景虚化更好、整体画质更高。
scenes.speak: Bigger sensors gather more light. Cleaner shots in low light.

scenes.context: 富士固定35mm无法光学变焦，Lumix从24mm广角延伸到75mm中长焦，构图灵活性明显更高。
scenes.speak: The Fuji is fixed at 35mm. The Lumix zooms from 24 to 75mm.

scenes.context: 富士凭4000万像素可裁切模拟35/50/70mm焦段，但本质是数字裁切会让文件变小。
sentences: High resolution allows cropping to other focal lengths.
paraphrase: High resolution allows cropping to other focal lengths.
scenes.speak: High resolution allows cropping to other focal lengths. Digital crops shrink the file.

scenes.context: Lumix变焦波杆更顺手不晃动，但定焦迫使摄影师移动身体构图，拍摄更有意识。
sentences: The zoom lever feels more natural.
A prime forces you to move and compose.
paraphrase: The zoom lever feels more natural.
A prime forces you to move and compose.
scenes.speak: The zoom lever feels more natural. A prime forces you to move and compose.

scenes.context: Lumix对焦反应更快更稳、人物识别几乎持续开启，富士偶尔错焦甚至随机失焦。
sentences: The Lumix autofocus is fast and steady.
paraphrase: The Lumix autofocus is fast and steady.
scenes.speak: The Lumix autofocus is fast and steady. The Fuji occasionally misses focus.

scenes.context: 富士以胶片模拟著称，Lumix提供实时LUT且可叠加，色彩自由度上Lumix更灵活。
sentences: Fuji is famous for film simulations.
paraphrase: Fuji is famous for film simulations.
scenes.speak: Fuji is famous for film simulations. Lumix imports custom LUTs.

practice: High resolution allows cropping to other focal lengths.
The Lumix autofocus is fast and steady.
pitfalls: 结合画幅、镜头和处理器
像素不是画质唯一指标
定焦逼你移动构图更走心
测试连续人像对焦表现
只看硬件不看色彩系统
